name: Slick Entity Reference
description: Provides Slick integration with Entity References.

suggests.drupal/entity_reference_revisions: Render entity_reference_revisions fields (e.g. Paragraphs) as a Slick carousel.
suggests.drupal/dynamic_entity_reference: Enables the Slick Dynamic Entity Reference Vanilla formatter for dynamic_entity_reference fields.

project_description:
Introduction 
 The Slick Entity Reference module provides a field formatter for Entity reference and Entity Reference Revisions fields to display entities as Slick Carousel items.

This allows richer slideshow/carousel content as you can reference whole entities and also customize their display modes.

 
  

 
 Features 
 
 Support Entity reference fields (such as nodes, taxonomy terms, etc.) 
 Support Entity Reference Revisions fields (such as Paragraphs ) 
 
 
  

 
 Versions 
 
 3.x: Supports Slick Carousel 3.x (recommended) 
 8.x-2.x: Supports Slick Carousel 8.x-2.x 
 8.x-1.x: Supports Slick Carousel 8.x-1.x 
 
 
  

 
 Requirements 
 
 Slick Carousel 
 Entity reference (Drupal 7 only)
 
 Note: In Drupal 8, Entity reference is part of Drupal 8 core and fully supported by this module 
 
 
 Entity Reference Revisions (optional, Drupal 8 only) 
 
 
  

 
 Installation and configuration 
 
 Install the module as usual 
 Change the display format of the desired entity reference field to "Slick carousel" 
 That's it, enjoy!
